title: R2 dashboard run (session) DTO
description: Presentation projection of a single agent-run session for the R2 observability dashboard. A 'run' is one session_id's worth of iterations discovered in a resolved iter-log root. RunSummary is the row shape returned by GET /api/runs; RunDetail (the full object) is returned by GET /api/runs/{session_id}. Sourced from internal/scoring.SessionScore plus iter-log walk over internal/scoring.IterationRecord. v1 is read-only; R5 augments this payload behind a composition point (e.g. a labels[] array) without forking the shape — so additionalProperties is false here to catch drift, and additive evolution happens via explicit new optional fields.

session_id.description: Stable session identifier (IterationRecord.Agent.SessionID). The addressable key for GET /api/runs/{session_id} and the session-<id>.score.yaml sidecar.

harness.description: Agent platform harness for the session (claude-code, codex, cursor). Taken from the most recent iteration's AgentInfo.Harness; empty when no iteration carried agent identity.

model.description: Model id for the session (AgentInfo.Model); empty when unknown.

wave.description: Plan id active at the session's last iteration (IterationRecord.Wave); empty when unknown.

rubric_version.description: Rubric version the session aggregate was scored under (SessionScore.RubricVersion). May differ from the active rubric reported by /api/rubric; the UI renders a mismatch pill (spec D3).

iteration_count.description: Number of iterations belonging to this session (len(SessionScore.Iterations)). 0 is valid for a session present in the log with no scorable iterations.

scored.description: False when no iteration in the session has a numeric score (SessionScore.Scored). When false, `score` is null and `band` is 'unscored'.

score.description: Mean of the scored per-iteration values (SessionScore.Value). null when scored is false. Never an error — missing scores degrade to null per spec R2.

band.description: Human-readable band for `score` (SessionScore.Band), or 'unscored' when scored is false.

first_iteration.description: Lowest iteration number in the session; null when iteration_count is 0.

last_iteration.description: Highest iteration number in the session; null when iteration_count is 0.

last_update.description: RFC3339 UTC mtime of the newest contributing iter-log or score sidecar file for the session. Drives the runs-grid 'last update' column and is the basis for the response ETag. null when no file mtime is resolvable.

iter_log_dir.description: Resolved iter-log root this session was discovered in (per design.md Q5 root list). Lets the client pass ?iter_log_dir= back on drill-down endpoints for non-active roots.

per_iteration.description: Lightweight per-iteration score refs (SessionScore.PerIteration) so the runs grid can sparkline a session without fetching every iteration sidecar. Present in RunDetail; omitted from RunSummary rows to keep the list payload small.

mean_cache_hit_rate.description: Mean of per-iteration session_tokens.cache_hit_rate across iterations that captured token telemetry; null when none did. Feeds the aggregate cache-trend view.
